ID: `jado-content-designer`.

## What it does

Selects better-writing for UI text, copywriting for new marketing copy and copy-editing to revise existing marketing copy. Applies only the relevant procedure, preserving meaning, voice and evidence for claims.

## When to use it

When labels, instructions, errors or marketing copy need to be written or revised.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-content-designer` in Claude Code or `$jado-content-designer` in Codex. Provide the text type, audience, goal, voice, glossary and sources for claims. For a mixed request, specify the sections: each section follows the relevant procedure.

## What it delivers

- Assigned strings or copy document
- Text for errors, confirmations and recovery
- Proposed meaning changes requiring a decision and handoff to the UI author

## Example

Rewrite the invitation form strings: initial instruction, email error, existing invitation and confirmation. Preserve the glossary and do not modify components.
